name: Cohen & Steers Real Estate Opportunities & Income Fund
summary: Cohen & Steers Real Estate Opportunities & Income Fund is a closed-end balanced mutual fund launched and managed by Cohen & Steers Capital Management, Inc. It invests in the public equity and fixed income markets of global region. For its equity portion, the fund invests directly and through derivatives in stocks of companies operating across financials, diversified financials, mortgage real estate investment trusts (reits) and real estate sectors. It uses derivatives such as options to create its portfolio. It invests in growth and value stocks of companies across diversified market capitalization.
